headline: US and India Prepare to Finalize Trade Agreement Within Weeks
summary: U.S. officials indicated that Washington and New Delhi are weeks away from finalizing a trade agreement, with energy purchases and bilateral ties remaining central to discussions.
why: Bilateral trade deals can reduce tariffs, boost cross-border investments, and impact supply chains for key industries operating between major emerging and developed economies.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: Trade agreement discussions between Washington and New Delhi could impact bilateral ties and energy purchases.
